rules.name: Conscript Militia
rules.description: Models with the Woodbury Commander keyword, and friendly Woodbury Army models within 3” of them, may spend 1SP to add 1Red to a Ranged Attack roll. However, if a Woodbury Army model begins its activation more than 3” from a Woodbury Commander, it loses 1 Action.

rules.name: Do As I Say! (Special Order)
rules.description: The Governor may spend 1SP to perform a single Action with a friendly model within 6”, even if the target model has already activated this round, and has already performed the same Action. It does not use an Action from either model. When this bonus Action is complete, play reverts back to the Governor (if he has any Actions remaining).

rules.name: Kill Them All! (Special Order, One Use)
rules.description: Spend 1SP and create NOISE. Brian Blake and every friendly Woodbury Army model within 6” add 1Red to their attack rolls (any type) for the remainder of the turn.

characteristics.name: Special Rules
characteristics.$text: Brian Blake, Mutilated and Merciless Only. Brian may use this item to increase the range of his Kill them All! Special Order to 12”, creating MAYHEM instead of NOISE.

rules.name: Trophy Hunter
rules.description: If Brian Blake kills an enemy Survivor in melee without causing a Headshot, do not replace the enemy with a Prone Walker. Instead, remove the model from play and gain 1 bonus Victory Point.

rules.name: Out of Shape
rules.description: Gabe can only Sneak 3” and run 6”.

rules.name: Up Close and Personal
rules.description: When using a weapon with the Handgun keyword in melee, Gloria adds 1Red to her attack rolls.

rules.name: Cunning (Strategy)
rules.description: Lilly may spend 1SP to add one bonus 1White to either her Melee, Shoot or Defense until the end of the round.

rules.name: Relunctant Leader
rules.description: If Lilly begins her activation 10" or more from a friendly Woodbury Commander, she gains the Woodbury Commander keyword until the end of the round.
